commit.message:
Share ordinary and doubled Pell ratio upper estimates

Generalize the common ratio-growth argument in the lower HilbertTenthProblem
PellRatio90 layer to a positive real error factor. Reuse it with factors one
and two in the existing upper_estimate' and NativeHalfBinomial
upper_estimate_scaled wrappers. Keep the ordinary theorem's hYr argument and
all other existing signatures/premises. The native doubled-coordinate proof
continues to recover the half-unit error using its unchanged k = 2K relation.

The common proof and both wrappers replace the duplicated 83-line native
argument. PellRatio90 grows by six lines and NativeHalfBinomial loses 83,
for a net reduction of 77 Lean lines and 3654 bytes including the helper.
No definitions, imports, recurrence equations or consistency premises change.

Validation: all 19 existing theorem statement texts are preserved. Both
touched modules, PellRatio3/Pell90/NativePopulationLower direct clients, two
existing native focus checks and public/helper axiom audits pass. Five old
public axiom reports are byte-identical; the new helper uses standard axioms.
An initial Pell90 import failed because Bootstrap90.olean was absent; building
only System90, Bootstrap90 and PellExponent90 resolved it and the unchanged
client then passed. Independent full exact-final static review also passes.

commit.display_title: Share ordinary and doubled Pell ratio upper estimates

title:
Share ordinary and doubled Pell ratio upper estimates

Generalize the common ratio-growth argument in the lower HilbertTenthProblem
PellRatio90 layer to a positive real error factor. Reuse it with factors one
and two in the existing upper_estimate' and NativeHalfBinomial
upper_estimate_scaled wrappers. Keep the ordinary theorem's hYr argument and
all other existing signatures/premises. The native doubled-coordinate proof
continues to recover the half-unit error using its unchanged k = 2K relation.

The common proof and both wrappers replace the duplicated 83-line native
argument. PellRatio90 grows by six lines and NativeHalfBinomial loses 83,
for a net reduction of 77 Lean lines and 3654 bytes including the helper.
No definitions, imports, recurrence equations or consistency premises change.

Validation: all 19 existing theorem statement texts are preserved. Both
touched modules, PellRatio3/Pell90/NativePopulationLower direct clients, two
existing native focus checks and public/helper axiom audits pass. Five old
public axiom reports are byte-identical; the new helper uses standard axioms.
An initial Pell90 import failed because Bootstrap90.olean was absent; building
only System90, Bootstrap90 and PellExponent90 resolved it and the unchanged
client then passed. Independent full exact-final static review also passes.
